extracted.name: Green spirulina smoothie
extracted.description: Start your day with a healthy smoothie. As well as being packed with nutrients, the deep green of spirulina adds rich vibrancy while avocado gives a silky texture
ingredient_lines: ½ small avocado peeled and stoned
10g mint plus a sprig to garnish (optional)
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a blender or food processor with 75ml cold water, and blitz until smooth. Or, put everything in a bowl and blitz with a hand blender.
Pour into a tall glass and garnish with a mint sprig, if you like. Drink straightaway.
